description: South Korean users are showing significantly less interest in domestic content. According to a report by the Korea Creative Content Agency, Korean Netflix users’ preference for domestic content on Netflix stood at 58.58 percent in the third quarter of this year, down 10.33 percentage points from the second quarter. title: Korean Netflix users’ preference for Korean content falls sharply: report

description: In the port city of Gunsan, North Jeolla Province, a bowl of jjamppong is as much a piece of local history as it is a meal. This weekend, the city is inviting visitors to taste its signature dish. The 2026 Gunsan Jjamppong Festival runs from Friday to Sunday at Baeknyeon Plaza in Jangmi-dong. The annual event aims to promote culinary tourism. title: Try Gunsan's signature spicy noodles at jjamppong festival

description: The first course was a crudo of olive flounder, sliced thin and dressed with citrus segments, pink peppercorns and a green herb oil. Flatfish is one of the most commonly eaten fish in Korea and a fixture of raw fish restaurants across the country. This one came from a farm in Jeonnam-Gwangju certified by the Aquaculture Stewardship Council, which is still unusual in the Korean market. Conrad Seoul served the dish at a luncheon for a small group of food journalists, titled "Today's Meal, a Choice
title: Inside Conrad Seoul's push for sustainable dining

description: "People call me first generation only because they don't know. There were others before her, she said, who wore makeup and entertained customers long before Seoul had bars that openly catered to them. description: A commemorative stamp honoring Lee Sang-hyeok, better known as Faker, a 30-year-old League of Legends star player for T1, will be issued Oct. 23. Korea Post, under the Ministry of Science and ICT, said Saturday it would issue 140,000 sheets of the stamps, along with stamp albums and other related items. title: Faker commemorative stamps issued

description: At least 38 people sustained minor injuries when parts of a ceiling collapsed at a supermarket in Daegu, South Korea, fire officials said Saturday. All 66 people inside the store evacuated after the collapse, which was reported at 10:16 a.m., according to the Daegu Fire Department. Nine of the injured were taken to hospitals. title: Ceiling collapse at Daegu building injures 38

description: South Korea's ambassador to Ukraine returned home Saturday after being recalled in protest of Kyiv's disclosure of the transfer of North Korean prisoners of war (POWs) to Seoul, the foreign ministry said. Ambassador Park Ki-chang arrived two days after the foreign ministry announced the recall in response to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's disclosure of the transfer and Kyiv's subsequent denial that it had agreed with Seoul to keep the matter confidential. title: S. Korean ambassador to Ukraine returns home amid dispute over N.K. POW disclosure

description: A British man in his 30s who fled to his home country after stabbing a woman in Seoul has been arrested in the United Kingdom, Korean police said Saturday. The Korean National Police Agency said the suspect was arrested in the UK on Thursday, local time, in cooperation with the UK’s National Extradition Unit (NEU).
